horizon-semantic-elevation-shadow-level1.$description: Actionable elements that need a subtle but noticeable separation from the ground — primary CTAs, nav bars, sticky headers.   Colour: horizon.semantic.color.shadow — 14% ink on light, 72% on dark.

horizon-semantic-elevation-shadow-level2.$description: Elements that temporarily rise during an interaction — a card on hover, an item being dragged.   Colour: horizon.semantic.color.shadow — 14% ink on light, 72% on dark.

horizon-semantic-elevation-shadow-level3.$description: Floating elements attached to a layout item — select and dropdown lists, popovers, colour and date pickers, tooltips, FAB. Measured in the master file as 0 4 16 at 10%.   Colour: horizon.semantic.color.shadow — 14% ink on light, 72% on dark.

horizon-semantic-elevation-shadow-level4.$description: Modals and dialogs. The most-used shadow in the product — 15 of 21 shadows in the master file are 0 8 24.   Colour: horizon.semantic.color.shadow — 14% ink on light, 72% on dark.

horizon-semantic-elevation-shadow-level5.$description: Full-screen overlays, drawers and bottom sheets — the only layer above a modal.   Colour: horizon.semantic.color.shadow — 14% ink on light, 72% on dark.
